caption: The drawing features two rectangular textile patterns presented on a beige background. The main, larger textile sample is a square with intricate alternating rows of floral and foliage designs in dark blue and cream colors. The flowers resemble large, fully bloomed roses, and ornate symmetrical leaves frame them. The pattern is repeated both horizontally and vertically, with a distinct horizontal band running across the middle, separating the upper floral motifs from the lower, more geometric leafy designs. The smaller rectangle at the bottom right of the page displays a close-up segment of the larger pattern, highlighting one section with two large, cream-colored flowers above a central, symmetrical leafy motif, all set against a dark blue background. Both samples use only the colors dark blue and cream, with the designs composed of tightly arranged and detailed lines, dots, and curves.
title: Coverlet
